command:
set -eu
t1=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
t2=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
rm -f "$t1" "$t2"
runuser -u nobody -- sh -c 'printf nobody-owned > /srv/drop/.[REDACTED]'
runuser -u daemon -- sh -c 'printf daemon-owned > /srv/drop/.[REDACTED]'
printf 'created_by_two_users:\n'
stat -c '%n owner=%U mode=%a size=%s' "$t1" "$t2"
if runuser -u daemon -- rm -f "$t1" 2>/tmp/[REDACTED]; then printf 'ERROR: daemon removed nobody file\n'; exit 1; else printf 'daemon_remove_nobody=blocked: '; tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/[REDACTED]; printf '\n'; fi
if runuser -u nobody -- rm -f "$t2" 2>/tmp/[REDACTED]; then printf 'ERROR: nobody removed daemon file\n'; exit 1; else printf 'nobody_remove_daemon=blocked: '; tr '\n' ' ' </tmp/[REDACTED]; printf '\n'; fi
runuser -u nobody -- rm -f "$t1"
runuser -u daemon -- rm -f "$t2"
rm -f /tmp/[REDACTED] /tmp/[REDACTED]
printf 'cleanup='; if [ ! -e "$t1" ] && [ ! -e "$t2" ]; then printf 'complete\n'; else printf 'failed\n'; exit 1; fi
printf 'final_directory='; stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G entries=%h' /srv/drop

command:
set -eu
probe=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
daemon_file=/srv/drop/.[REDACTED]
rm -f "$daemon_file"
printf 'boot_id='; cat /proc/sys/kernel/random/boot_id
printf 'system_state='; systemctl is-system-running
printf 'selinux='; getenforce
printf 'directory='; ls -ldZ /srv/drop
runuser -u daemon -- sh -c 'printf daemon-postrestart > /srv/drop/.[REDACTED]'
printf 'shared_write='; stat -c 'owner=%U mode=%a size=%s' "$daemon_file"
if runuser -u daemon -- rm -f "$probe" 2>/tmp/antrieb_post_err1; then printf 'ERROR: daemon removed nobody probe\n'; exit 1; else printf 'daemon_remove_nobody=blocked\n'; fi
if runuser -u nobody -- rm -f "$daemon_file" 2>/tmp/antrieb_post_err2; then printf 'ERROR: nobody removed daemon file\n'; exit 1; else printf 'nobody_remove_daemon=blocked\n'; fi
runuser -u daemon -- rm -f "$daemon_file"
runuser -u nobody -- rm -f "$probe"
rm -f /tmp/antrieb_post_err1 /tmp/antrieb_post_err2
printf 'cleanup='; if [ -z "$(find /srv/drop -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -print -quit)" ]; then printf 'directory_empty\n'; else printf 'unexpected_entries_remain\n'; find /srv/drop -mindepth 1 -maxdepth 1 -printf '%f\n'; exit 1; fi
printf 'final='; stat -c 'mode=%a owner=%U group=%G' /srv/drop
